description: Grant or revoke specific permissions for an account on a specific instance (by id or exact name). Pass only the nodes you want to change. Every other node keeps its current value. Call list_instance_users first to see who has access and what they hold. The owner's own access cannot be changed, and `instance.view` is always kept.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be changed, naming the user and each permission they gain or lose and getting their approval.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

permissions.description: Permission flags to apply, keyed by node, e.g. {"instance.console.**": true, "instance.files.read": true}. A `.**` node covers its whole group, and a single node like "instance.status.start" grants just that action. Only the listed nodes change. "instance.permissions.manage" lets them change everyone's access, including their own.

user.description: Account id, or an exact username of 3+ characters to look up.

name: set_user_permissions
title: Set User Permissions
